content:
STAGE 1 - scope and landscape
GOAL: fix the admissible design space for one hyperbolic SID-table quality metric before committing to a formula.
READ: the full task brief only; attempted to read running.json, opencode.json, session.jsonl and the parent round dir, all permission-denied; glob shows only this agent's five files, so no data/config is inspectable.
OBSERVED: the brief lists every measured construction: HBAA (Gromov common-ancestor of level-1 prefix vs full training history, mean over ~10 negatives) +0.701; its anchor/Euclidean/flat/pair-accuracy variants 0.69-0.70; all partition-geometry metrics (Voronoi margin, adj-R2, Frechet cover radius, bucket reach, softmax path, cell expected rank/lift, size-matched-kept) fail or are weak; Q_H +0.634.
REASONING: the only sanctioned route to beat HBAA is more information on the same contrastive inputs: (a) the full negative distribution instead of its mean, and/or (b) a richer query/item side. The one information source named in the contract but absent from every measured metric is the reference's TARGET representation per item (HBAA uses source reps). A geodesic midpoint of source and target is an explicitly curved object and a conservative way to inject the target side (regresses to the source anchor as s->t).
EVIDENCE: brief statements on HBAA and its controls; no local files readable.
OPEN: pick the aggregation (mean margin vs temperatured expected rank vs pair accuracy) and the exact null so a one-code table is exactly 0.

STAGE 2 - design decision
GOAL: choose a construction that differs from all measured ones and is implementable in <1 min.
DECISION: hyp_bmid_erank. Anchors are Frechet barycentres (unit Poincare ball) of the geodesic MIDPOINTS m_j = exp_{s_j}(0.5 log_{s_j}(t_j)); the query is the per-pair Frechet barycentre of history SOURCE reps. Alignment is the metric Gromov product Gamma = 0.5(d(u,0)+d(a,0)-d(u,a)). Aggregation is the full-negative temperatured expected rank (mean sigmoid of per-negative Gamma gaps), mapped to a skill score M = 1 - 2*mean_r rho_r so all-equal and random give 0.
REASONING: this keeps the proven Gromov contrast but changes (i) the item side to behaviour midpoints (target info, unused by any measured metric), (ii) the negative side from a mean margin to the full distribution (tail sensitivity, the brief's explicit suggestion), (iii) the scale to a per-table random null so collapse cannot be rewarded (the failure that killed the plain softmax path). Curvature enters through d_H, the geodesic midpoint, and the Frechet barycentre, not through a Euclidean distance. Fixed constants: tau = tau_ref * mean anchor radius (tau_ref read from frozen reference, no tuning); curvature fixed to the reference's (scale cancels in the ratio).
EVIDENCE: by construction; no measurement possible here.
OPEN: state the exact Frechet routine, edge cases (cell with no training items), and the worst-case table in the final block.

STAGE 3 - FINAL ANSWER (summary; full text is in the response)
METRIC: hyp_bmid_erank. TITLE: Hyperbolic behaviour-midpoint common-ancestor expected-rank alignment of level-1 SID cells.
GOAL: propose one in-scope hyperbolic SID-quality metric that differs from HBAA and from all measured metrics.
CONSTRUCTION: unit Poincare ball, curvature -1. Per TRAIN item j, behaviour midpoint m_j = exp_{s_j}(0.5 log_{s_j}(t_j)) (geodesic midpoint of source and target; target side is unused by every measured metric). Level-1 anchor a_c = Frechet barycentre of {m_j : c_1(j)=c, j in TRAIN}. Per training pair, query u_r = Frechet barycentre of history source reps {s_j : j in H_r}. Alignment Gamma_r(c) = 0.5(d_H(u_r,0)+d_H(a_c,0)-d_H(u_r,a_c)), the metric Gromov product (common-ancestor depth). Full-negative temperatured expected rank: rho_r = mean_{n in N_r} sigmoid((Gamma_r(c_1(n))-Gamma_r(c_1(p_r)))/tau), tau = tau_ref * Rbar with Rbar = mean_c d_H(0,a_c) and tau_ref the frozen reference temperature. M = 1 - 2*mean_r rho_r, in [-1,1], higher better.
WHAT IT ADDS: target-side geodesic midpoints (new information), the full negative distribution instead of the mean of ten margins, and a per-table random-rank null so collapse scores exactly 0. Keeps the proven Gromov contrast but changes the item side, the aggregation and the null. Curvature enters via d_H, the geodesic midpoint and the Frechet barycentres; not a Euclidean distance.
INPUTS: SID table level-1 codes (24587 items, <=256 codes); frozen reference TRAIN source/target per item, TRAIN pairs (H_r,p_r,N_r,|N_r|=10), curvature and tau_ref; TRAIN split. No val/test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 output.
COMPUTE: O(N d) midpoints + O(200 N d) Frechet + O(sum_r |H_r| d) queries; vectorised numpy, well under one minute.
RISKS: target reps noisier than source (degrades gracefully to source as t->s); tau_ref unit mismatch only saturates/flattens rho; cells with no TRAIN item are dropped as negatives; small R/|N_r| is noisy; fixed Frechet seed required.
FAILURE MODE: the all-one-code table gives identical Gamma, rho=0.5, M=0 exactly; a uniformly random relabelling of the 256 codes is also ~0 (never rewarded).
STATUS: proposal complete; no measurement possible in this sandbox (all data files permission-denied).
